maria: Heads-up: on long streaming tool-loop runs (multi-window chat + function calls) we're seeing steady RSS growth even with KV cache TTL set. ~30MB growth per 10k tokens on a single worker.
ash: repro steps? which config / model / quantization?
maria: repro: rtx-a100, model=redwood-v1-qlora, batch=1 streaming, kv_ttl=600s, kv_compact_interval=0 (disabled). script: run_toolloop.sh -> loop 50k tokens.
lee: can you paste `pmap`/`smem` snapshot at 0 and after ~50k tokens?
maria: attached quick dump (snipped):
```
0s: rss=1.8G, anon=1.3G, kv_resident=420M
50k tokens: rss=1.86G, anon=1.36G, kv_resident=448M
delta ~28M kv_resident
```
ash: that's small per run but linear over time. did you see slab fragmentation metric from the runtime tracer?
maria: ran perf trace: `kv.slab_fragmentation=0.14`, `kv.free_pages=4`, `kv.orphan_pages=11`, page_ages skewed to old side.
devops-bot: Deploybot: workspace/ci/bench-toolloop logged: OOM risk at ~2.2B tokens if growth continues.
nate: sounds like pages are not being returned to freelist, maybe a refcount leak on toolchain page handoff. any long-lived iterators keeping refs?
maria: interesting — tool loop holds references to last 3 responses for reranking, but that should be short-lived. i inspected page_refcounts via `kv-debug`:
```
page 0: refs=1
page 1: refs=1
page 2: refs=0
page 3: refs=2
page 4: refs=1
orphaned_pages=11
```
lee: run `KV_DEBUG=1 ./server --kv-allocator-checks` and capture the log around compaction/evict events. also try enabling `kv_compact_interval=10s` to force early compaction.
maria: did that, logs show compaction runs but compactor only consolidates pages if contiguous; we have many small scattered free segments.
sophia: could be fragmentation from variable-sized page allocations after the kernel selection change (the quantized kernels altered block alignment). any recent commits touching allocator or kernel mem alignment?
ash: there was a change two weeks ago in kernel-selection that switched some matmul kernels to 64B alignment instead of 128B for smaller sequences to boost throughput on some GPUs. cc @infra.
nate: alignment change could increase internal fragmentation and prevent coalescing if headers expect 128B boundaries. run a bisect on kernel align commits.
maria: did a quick bisect: regression appears after commit 1a2b3c (kernel-select: prefer small-aligned kernels). repro toggle: revert that alignment -> free_pages jumps from 4 -> 28 and orphaned_pages drops to 2, memory growth disappears in 30k token test.
lee: good find. mitigation options:
- patch allocator coalescer to ignore alignment padding when merging free segments
- add periodic full compaction pass (expensive) on low-load windows
- revert alignment change but lose perf win on some workloads
sophia: we should avoid full revert. propose quick fix: coalescer-aware padding-trim: when merging adjacent free segments, allow trimming trailing alignment slack up to 128B to enable coalescing. cheap and localized.
maria: wrote a prototype change to `kv_allocator::coalesce()` — small check and adjust neighbor start by up to ALIGN_BYTES and merge. test run: 50k token loop -> kv_resident delta ~+2MB only, orphaned_pages -> 1.
ash: can you paste the small snippet or pseudocode so infra can review? put in PR with perf numbers.
maria: snippet:
```
if (left.end + padding <= right.start) {
  // allow merge by trimming padding
  left.end += padding_trim; // <= ALIGN_BYTES
  merge(left, right);
}
```
lee: add unit test for adjacent fragments with alignment gaps. also add metric `kv.coalesces_trimmed` to track frequency.
sophia: operational: create a canary image with this patch on dedicated test cluster and run 24h toolloop smoke. also update rollout doc to include rollback steps if perf regresses.
devops-bot: Issue opened: RED-issue-3948 "kv coalesce alignment-trim to mitigate toolloop memory growth" by maria. PR draft attached.
maria: thanks all. next steps: review, canary, then if stable -> ship and schedule a follow-up to re-evaluate kernel alignment perf tradeoff.
ash: also add a short-term config flag `kv_allow_alignment_trim=true` so we can toggle without redeploying code.
maria: will add flag + metrics, pushing PR now. :thumbsup:
